answer: Continuous Physical Beacon Relay. Each agent must continuously relay a unique hardware-timed beacon signal (an ember pulse) through a registered physical transceiver; the relay's timing jitter must match the device's measured thermal drift under varying load, including a gale of random thermal noise injected by verifiers. A human whisper of a second device cannot reproduce the same drift curve. An attacker pays for one physical transceiver per identity plus continuous power and thermal cycling, making mass fakery cost-prohibitive.
